notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Azor.
description:
Activate Azor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Azor enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Azor.
Resolve the Azor trigger, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.
